sections.title: Secret Caves
sections.note: The 20 caves on the Secret Cave Chart.

items.name: Star Island cave
items.howTo: Blow up (or lift) the boulder in the south-west and survive the waves of Magtails, Bokoblins and Moblins.

items.name: Overlook Island cave
items.howTo: Hookshot up the palm trees to the top, clear the four side rooms and the Darknuts in the middle, then conduct the Wind's Requiem on the symbol.
items.notes: In Wind Waker HD the chest holds Triforce Shard 8 itself.

items.name: Pawprint Isle ChuChu cave
items.howTo: Crawl into the hole in the central dome and follow the ChuChu tunnels; Bombs open two side branches and the Grappling Hook reaches a ledge.
items.notes: Also a Joy Pendant, a Purple Rupee and a Red Rupee.

items.name: Pawprint Isle Wizzrobe cave
items.howTo: Hookshot to the odd tree on the islet at one of the isle's toes and beat three waves of Wizzrobes and the monsters they summon.
items.notes: In Wind Waker HD the chest holds Treasure Chart 46.

items.name: Dragon Roost Island cave
items.howTo: Blow up (or lift) the boulder near the Wind Shrine and fight through the Keese, Mothulas, ChuChus and Bokoblins.

items.name: Rock Spire Isle cave
items.howTo: Clear the boulders on the path, then light the dark cave's torches with a Boko Stick and defeat all the Keese.

items.name: Fire Mountain cave
items.howTo: Freeze the volcano with an Ice Arrow, climb in through the top within five minutes and defeat the Magtails.

items.name: Needle Rock Isle cave
items.howTo: Melt the ice over the entrance with a Fire Arrow and light the dark maze's six torches.

items.name: Stone Watcher Island cave
items.howTo: Lift the stone head with the Power Bracelets, clear the four combat rooms and the Darknut, then conduct the Wind's Requiem on the symbol.
items.notes: In Wind Waker HD the chest holds Triforce Shard 7 itself.

items.name: Cabana Labyrinth
items.howTo: Show the Cabana Deed at Mrs. Marie's Cabana, pull the lever above the fireplace with the Grappling Hook, and work through the labyrinth under the chimney with the Skull Hammer.
items.notes: Also an Orange Rupee on the lower floor. The upper chest needs the Wind's Requiem. In Wind Waker HD it holds Triforce Shard 2 itself.

items.name: Bomb Island cave
items.howTo: Blow up (or lift) the huge rock at the top, then stun the Magtails and use them to hold down the floor switches.

items.name: Bird's Peak Rock cave
items.howTo: Fly a seagull (Hyoi Pear) into the switches on the Kargarocs' nests to open the grate, then conduct the Wind's Requiem on the symbol.

items.name: Diamond Steppe Island cave
items.howTo: Hookshot from ledge to ledge to the top and pick the right warp pots through the maze, past the Floormasters.
items.notes: Also a Joy Pendant.

items.name: Shark Island cave
items.howTo: Within the time limit press all four switches (Iron Boots plate, Skull Hammer switch, crystal switch and floor switch), then survive the Miniblins, Moblins, Darknuts and Wizzrobes.

items.name: Ice Ring Isle cave
items.howTo: Thaw the isle with a Fire Arrow and slide down to the Iron Boots within five minutes; wear them to push into the inner cave behind the wind.
items.notes: The inner cave's chest holds an Orange Rupee.

items.name: Cliff Plateau Isles cave
items.howTo: Drop into the hole on the low islet, burn the way through with a Boko Stick and glide out on top of the tall isle with the Deku Leaf.
items.notes: The exit leads to Treasure Chart 25's chest outside.

items.name: Horseshoe Island cave
items.howTo: Finish the Deku Nut golf, go down the hole that opens and defeat the Winged Mothula and two Mothulas.

items.name: Savage Labyrinth
items.howTo: Lift the stone head on the hill with the Power Bracelets and fight down the floors. Floor 30 needs the Wind's Requiem; floors 31 to 50 need the Mirror Shield and Skull Hammer.
items.notes: Triforce Chart 6 is on floor 30, the Piece of Heart on floor 50. Wind Waker HD has Triforce Shard 6 on floor 30 and the Hero's Charm on floor 50.

items.name: Angular Isles cave
items.howTo: Hookshot to the tree on the small isle (or glide there), solve the block tower and reflect light onto the chest with the Mirror Shield.
items.notes: The Piece of Heart on the big isle's summit is separate.

items.name: Boating Course cave
items.howTo: Glide to the north isle (or Hookshot the pole) and hit the three diamond switches at once from range while Miniblins keep coming.

items.name: Northern Fairy Island submarine
items.howTo: Climb into the submarine. Swing across the ropes to the back room; the Moblins below are optional.

items.name: Crescent Moon Island submarine
items.howTo: Climb into the submarine. Defeat all the Miniblins to drop the ladder.

items.name: Flight Control Platform submarine
items.howTo: Climb into the submarine. Press the switch and defeat the Wizzrobes it releases to drop the ladder.

items.name: Six-Eye Reef submarine
items.howTo: Climb into the submarine. Defeat the three Moblins to drop the ladder.

items.name: Bomb Island submarine
items.howTo: Climb into the submarine. Defeat all the Bokoblins to make the chest appear.

items.name: Headstone Island submarine
items.howTo: Climb into the submarine. Defeat the Rats carrying bombs to drop the ladder; you can't leave until they're gone.

items.name: Five-Star Isles submarine
items.howTo: Climb into the submarine. Defeat the Bokoblins and Keese to drop the ladder.

sections.title: Lookout Platforms
sections.note: Grouped by sea square, as on the Platform Chart.

items.howTo: Clear the Bokoblins (and any Kargarocs or Wizzrobes) off the platform and open the chest; the Grappling Hook steals from Bokoblins too.
